name: get_mac_status
description: PROACTIVE. Read live Mac device state: battery, wifi, volume, focused app, or all. Use when the owner asks about battery/charge, wifi/network, volume/mute, or what app is frontmost. Call immediately — no confirmation. Do NOT use when: controlling the Mac (open app, set volume, type, reminders — use mac_run_actions), browser work (browser_run_actions), public web facts (web_search), or multi-step ambiguous tasks (mac_delegate). Never invent readings; always call this tool instead of guessing numbers.

fields.description: Optional status fields to fetch. Omit or use ["all"] for a full snapshot.

spoken_reply.description: Short pendant confirmation (e.g. "Checking battery."). One sentence.

transcript.description: Optional history label only. Omit if unsure — never block on this.
